runs.content: YTD 2026 (all through Aug 28, independently compounded from Q1 x Q2 x Q3 -- matched ETFreplay's own annual/YTD readout to within rounding this run, no discrepancies found): IWN +23.9%, IWD +23.7%, IWM +20.6%, QQQ +16.9%, SPY +13.4%, IVE +12.8%, IWF +3.9%. Growth vs value spread: IWD +23.7% vs IWF +3.9% -> value leads by 1980 bps, down from 2060 bps on Aug 26 -- a second compression this quarter after the brief Aug 7 dip. Notable: growth stabilized over the final two days of August -- IWF's Q3 partial improved from -2.0% to -1.1% (YTD +3.1% -> +3.9%) and QQQ's Q3 partial improved from -3.4% to -2.7% (YTD +16.1% -> +16.9%) -- while value/small caps gave back a little ground (IWD flat at +23.7%, IVE +13.0% -> +12.8%, IWM +21.9% -> +20.6%, IWN +24.6% -> +23.9%). QQQ-IWF divergence held flat at 1300 bps. IWN remains top YTD performer, just ahead of IWD.
